name: @piprail/example-nano-x402
description: PipRail merchant that also accepts Nano (XNO) via the x402 exact scheme — feeless, sub-second settlement beside EVM-USDC.
comment: Nano needs no peer chain library: the Nano exact scheme (@x402nano/exact + @x402nano/helper) talks to the ledger over its plain HTTP RPC with no per-tx gas.
